Enable Gray Turkey.Description: Enables the Gray/Ocellated Turkey texture and adds it to the possible turkey appearances.

Disable Special Order.Description: Disables the Special Order to unlock animals at Marnie's. Turn on to have Marnie sell animals by default provided the appropriate housing is built.

Disable Meat Recipes.Description: Disables meat-based recipes/books. Primarily for users who play with Animal Husbandry without having meat/butchering turned on.
